I trust justin ATM 🙂 I'm also confused here cause I had computed 13 for mainnet 😅 and messed up by 1 when I added a field and forgot to update if we normally interop on mainnet preset, maybe I got on 14 in that config actually (and my local interop i use to run is actually mainnet based so there might be a mystery here) we never checked KZG inclusion in interop we ignored DA and I never merged my proofs PR <@504202741933932544> <@755590043632140352> I saw and we calculated 21 https://github.com/Consensys/teku/commit/38ebce7e7adedb9544ccb5d094b868ca1dbf1422 I'm checking it right now, 21 seems fine, I am just trying to backtrack how is it that I missed for so mcuh Ahhh I think I know, I think this is because I wanted originally to prove agains the payload envelope and not the block <@592004585506340885> this solves the mistery, approving your PR thanks a lot for it. I hereby swear I'll prioritize sanitizing ePBS next week with the remaining minor changes. It'd be nice to get static vectors to give other teams No worries haha, thanks 🙏 lol. Cant trust my memory at all.
